# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Email **care@pinpointventures.in**. Please do not open a public issue for a vulnerability.

Include a description of the problem, the steps to reproduce it and what it
would let someone do.

You will get an acknowledgement within 48 hours, and a fix for a critical issue
within 7 days.

## Scope

In scope: cross-site scripting, injection, exposed credentials or personal
data, and changes to published content by someone who should not be able to
make them.

For this repository that includes the source map and anything that could identify a private person.

Out of scope: denial of service, social engineering, and vulnerabilities in
third-party services this site uses.

## Licence, forks and takedowns

See [LICENSE](../LICENSE). The code is MIT. The text and data are CC BY 4.0,
which allows reuse with credit to Varna Sri Raman and WhoGaveTheOrder.in.

A fork must keep that credit, must keep the source on every claim, and must not
add the name of a private individual, a complainant or a victim, or any
contributor's contact details, to the repository.

If you find a copy that removes the credit, or that adds such names:

1. Note the URL and the files concerned.
2. File a notice with GitHub at https://github.com/contact, following its DMCA
   policy where the credit has been removed.
3. Tell care@pinpointventures.in so it is tracked. Anything that identifies a
   private person is urgent: write to us first.

Requests to take down or correct a record go to legal@whogavetheorder.in or
corrections@whogavetheorder.in, as the About page says.
